questions.question: If the 4th day of a month is Sunday, which of the following would be the 6th day before the 30th day of that month?
questions.questionHtml: If the 4th day of a month is Sunday, which of the following would be the 6th day before the 30th day of that month?
questions.solution:
4th day of the month is Sunday.

So,

(4 + 7) = 11th day is Sunday

(11 + 7) = 18th day is Sunday

(18 + 7) = 25th day is Sunday


So 6th day before the 30th day is 24th

If 25th is Sunday, 24th is Saturday

Hence, ‘Saturday’ is the correct answer.

Directions: Answer the question given below

You have made a mistake in a criminal investigation and arrested the wrong person while the real culprit is free. Your boss has a doubt on this and asks details of the matter. What will you do?

options.text: Claim that the person you have arrested is the criminal and use the evidence that led you to arrest him.
options.html: Claim that the person you have arrested is the criminal and use the evidence that led you to arrest him.

options.text: Tell your boss the truth, apologize and find the real culprit.
options.html: Tell your boss the truth, apologize and find the real culprit.

questions.solution:
Since you have made a mistake, it is your responsibility to accept it and make amends. So option 2 is correct.

Options 1 and 4 are wrong ways of action. So they are eliminated.

Option 3 is also incorrect since you are not taking any steps to amend your mistake.

Hence the correct answer is option 2.

questions.question: The average monthly income of A and B is Rs 14000, that of B and C is Rs 15600 and A and C is Rs 14400. Then the monthly income of C is?
questions.questionHtml: The average monthly income of A and B is Rs 14000, that of B and C is Rs 15600 and A and C is Rs 14400. Then the monthly income of C is?
questions.solution:
Given:

average monthly income of A and B = Rs 14000

average monthly income of B and C = Rs 15600

average monthly income of A and C = Rs 14400

Then,

Sum of incomes,

⇒ A + B = 14000 × 2 = 28000 → equation i)

⇒ B + C = 15600 × 2 = 31200 → equation ii)

⇒ A + C = 14400 × 2 = 28800 → equation iii)

Adding we get,

2(A + B + C) = 88000

A + B + C = 44000

Income of C = A + B + C - (A + B)

Income of C = 44000 - 28000 = Rs 16000

Hence, the correct answer is "Rs 16000".

questions.question: Which of the two signs should be interchanged in order to make the following equation correct? 219 + 512 × 8 ÷ 18 - 3 = 1368
questions.questionHtml:
Which of the two signs should be interchanged in order to make the following equation correct? 

219 + 512 × 8 ÷ 18 - 3 = 1368
questions.solution:
Given Equation:

219 + 512 × 8 ÷ 18 - 3 = 1368

BODMAS Rule:

1) - and +

LHS = 219 - 512 x 8 ÷ 18 + 3

⇒ 219 - 512 x 0.44 + 3

⇒ 219 - 225.28 + 3

⇒ 228.28 - 219

⇒ -3.28 ≠ 1368 (L.H.S ≠ R.H.S)

2) ÷ and ​x

LHS = 219 + 512 ÷ 8 x 18 - 3

⇒ 219 + 64 x 18 - 3

⇒ 219 + 1152 - 3

⇒ 1371 - 3

⇒ 1368 = 1368 (L.H.S = R.H.S)

3) × and +

LHS = 219 x 512 + 8 ÷ 18 - 3

⇒ 219 x 512 + 0.44 - 3

⇒ 112128 + 0.44 - 3

⇒ 112128.44 - 3

⇒ 112125.44 ≠ 1368 (L.H.S ≠ R.H.S)

4) + and ÷

LHS = 219 ÷ 512 x 8 + 18 - 3

⇒ 0.427 x 8 + 18 - 3

⇒ 3.416 + 18 - 3

⇒ 21.416 - 3

⇒ 18.416 ≠ 1368 (L.H.S ≠ R.H.S)

Hence, “÷ and ​×” is the correct answer.

questions.question: All the persons in a row are facing North, A is 31 st from right and B is 13 th from the right. If A and B exchange the positions, what is the position of A from left if 35 persons are there in the row?
questions.questionHtml: All the persons in a row are facing North, A is 31<sup>st</sup> from right and B is 13<sup>th</sup> from the right. If A and B exchange the positions, what is the position of A from left if 35 persons are there in the row?
questions.solution:
As per the question,

All the persons in a row are facing North. There are 35 persons in the row.

  • A is 31st from the right and B is 13th from the right.

​

  • If A and B exchange the positions:

​

→ After exchanging the position, B is 31st and A is 13th from the right respectively.

Now,

The position of A from the left = Total persons in the row  -Position of A from the right + 1 

= 35 -13 + 1

= 22 + 1

= 23

Thus, the position of A from the left will be '23rd'.

Hence, the correct answer is "23".
